subject: Film & Cinema
title: Anime: A Global Phenomenon
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Anime: A Global Phenomenon.

hook.text: Anime isn't a genre — it's an entire industry with more variety than Hollywood.

buildup.text: From Astro Boy in 1963 to Demon Slayer today, anime spans every genre and age group.

discovery.text: Akira in 1988 stunned Western audiences with animation so fluid it rivaled live-action filmmaking.

twist.text: Despite global popularity, anime studios pay animators poverty wages for grueling work.

climax.text: Anime's influence on global animation — from Avatar to Spider-Verse — is now undeniable.
